claim.asserts: These artifacts and this trace came from one imagine session, unaltered since sealing.
claim.does_not_assert: Anything about who ran the session, whether the artifacts are sound, or whether their declared lanes are true. The signing key is ephemeral and travels inside the bundle; ground it to find out.

artifacts.name: symbia.sink.log
artifacts.description: Writes the message to the Logging service log stream (config.level, default "info"; config.message template prefix optional) and passes the input through on "out". Unlike symbia.io.log, which only writes to the execution trace, this persists to the platform log store.

level.description: Log level written to the platform log store.

message.description: Optional prefix placed before the serialised message value.

manifest.description: Writes the message to the Logging service log stream (config.level, default "info"; config.message template prefix optional) and passes the input through on "out". Unlike symbia.io.log, which only writes to the execution trace, this persists to the platform log store.

artifacts.name: symbia.sink.metric
artifacts.description: Writes a numeric data point to the Logging metrics service, attributed to the org that owns the graph. config.name is the metric name (a gauge series is resolved or created on first use); config.valueField (default "value") locates the number in the message — dotted paths supported (e.g. "out.result"); config.labels attaches labels. Passes the input through on "out"; non-numeric values and failed writes exit on "error".

outputs.name: error
outputs.laneNote: a write that failed, or a value that was not numeric — in neither case did the series receive what the graph computed

name.description: Metric name. A gauge series is resolved or created on first use.

valueField.description: Locates the number in the message. Dotted paths supported, e.g. "out.result".

labels.description: Labels attached to the data point.

manifest.description: Writes a numeric data point to the Logging metrics service, attributed to the org that owns the graph. config.name is the metric name (a gauge series is resolved or created on first use); config.valueField (default "value") locates the number in the message — dotted paths supported (e.g. "out.result"); config.labels attaches labels. Passes the input through on "out"; non-numeric values and failed writes exit on "error".

artifacts.name: symbia.source.timer
artifacts.description: Emits {tick, ts} on "out" every config.intervalMs milliseconds (default 5000, min 100) while the execution is running. config.payload (object) is merged into each tick. Driven by the executor; injecting into a timer node manually also works and emits one tick.

outputs.name: out
outputs.laneNote: a tick is generated by the platform from declared config; nothing external is asserted

intervalMs.description: Milliseconds between ticks. Floored at 100 by the executor, which owns the interval.

payload.description: Merged into each tick alongside {tick, ts}.

manifest.description: Emits {tick, ts} on "out" every config.intervalMs milliseconds (default 5000, min 100) while the execution is running. config.payload (object) is merged into each tick. Driven by the executor; injecting into a timer node manually also works and emits one tick.

artifacts.name: symbia.state.rollup
artifacts.description: Aggregates the latest values of an expected key set (config.expected: [keys], config.op: sum|mean|min|max, keyField (default "key") / valueField as in join). Emits {value, op, coverage, present, missing} on "out". A rollup with missing inputs is emitted on the apocryphal lane: a partial total must not pass as the total.

outputs.name: out
outputs.laneNote: canonical only when missing is empty; a rollup with any expected key absent is emitted apocryphal, because a partial total must not pass as the total

expected.description: The key set that constitutes a complete rollup. This is what makes "missing" meaningful — without it, coverage is 1 by vacuous default and every partial total looks complete.

op.description: Aggregation applied to the present values.

keyField.description: Field locating the key in each message.

valueField.description: Field locating the numeric value in each message.

manifest.description: Aggregates the latest values of an expected key set (config.expected: [keys], config.op: sum|mean|min|max, keyField (default "key") / valueField as in join). Emits {value, op, coverage, present, missing} on "out". A rollup with missing inputs is emitted on the apocryphal lane: a partial total must not pass as the total.

artifacts.name: symbia.state.window
artifacts.description: Keeps the last config.size (default 60) numeric values of config.field (default "value") and emits {count, sum, mean, min, max, last} on every input.

outputs.name: out
outputs.laneNote: the aggregate is only as canonical as the values that entered the window, and a window that has not filled reports over fewer values without saying so — read "count" against "size"

size.description: How many values the window keeps. Floored at 1.

field.description: Field holding the numeric value. Non-numeric exits on "error".

manifest.description: Keeps the last config.size (default 60) numeric values of config.field (default "value") and emits {count, sum, mean, min, max, last} on every input.

artifacts.name: symbia.state.join
artifacts.description: Joins the latest values of selected keys from a keyed stream. config.select maps output fields to key values, e.g. {"x": "key.one", "y": "key.two"}; config.keyField (default "key") and config.valueField (default "value") locate key and value in each message. Emits the joined object on "out" once every selected key has been seen (then on every update); until then emits {have, need} on "pending".

outputs.name: pending
outputs.laneNote: {have, need} is a statement about coverage, not a joined value — it must never be mistaken for the join

select.description: Output field to key value, e.g. {"x": "key.one"}. Keys of this object become the fields of the joined result; an empty select can never complete.

keyField.description: Field locating the key in each message.

valueField.description: Field locating the value in each message.

manifest.description: Joins the latest values of selected keys from a keyed stream. config.select maps output fields to key values, e.g. {"x": "key.one", "y": "key.two"}; config.keyField (default "key") and config.valueField (default "value") locate key and value in each message. Emits the joined object on "out" once every selected key has been seen (then on every update); until then emits {have, need} on "pending".

artifacts.name: symbia.state.latest
artifacts.description: Remembers the most recent message per config.keyField (default "key") and passes the message through. The current snapshot {key: message} is available downstream via the "snapshot" port.

outputs.name: snapshot
outputs.laneNote: the snapshot is as canonical as the messages that built it; it carries no freshness guarantee and a key may be arbitrarily stale

keyField.description: Field locating the key in each message. A message without it is passed through and remembered under nothing.

manifest.description: Remembers the most recent message per config.keyField (default "key") and passes the message through. The current snapshot {key: message} is available downstream via the "snapshot" port.

artifacts.name: symbia.io.delay
artifacts.description: Waits config.ms milliseconds, then passes through.

ms.description: Milliseconds to wait. Capped at 5000 by the handler.

manifest.description: Waits config.ms milliseconds, then passes through.

artifacts.name: symbia.io.http-request
artifacts.description: Fetches config.url. Output is apocryphal: a remote body cannot be recomputed from the graph.

outputs.name: out
outputs.laneNote: a remote body cannot be recomputed from the graph

manifest.description: Fetches config.url. Output is apocryphal: a remote body cannot be recomputed from the graph.

artifacts.name: symbia.compute.arithmetic
artifacts.description: Exact arithmetic over config.expression with {placeholders} from the message. Canonical: recomputable.

outputs.name: out
outputs.laneNote: recomputable from the expression and its inputs

outputs.name: error
outputs.laneNote: a refusal is not a recomputable value

expression.description: Arithmetic over {placeholders} resolved from fields of the incoming message, e.g. "({a} - {b}) / {a}". Only digits, whitespace and + - * / ( ) survive the guard.

manifest.description: Exact arithmetic over config.expression with {placeholders} from the message. Canonical: recomputable.

artifacts.name: symbia.logic.switch
artifacts.description: Emits on the port named by config.field's value, if that port is listed in config.ports; otherwise "default".

field.description: Field whose value names the output port.

ports.description: Port names this switch may emit on. A value not listed here goes to "default" — the allowlist is what stops a message inventing a port.

manifest.description: Emits on the port named by config.field's value, if that port is listed in config.ports; otherwise "default".

artifacts.name: symbia.logic.filter
artifacts.description: Routes on a predicate: config.field / config.op (eq,neq,gt,lt,contains,exists) / config.value.

field.description: Field to test. Omitted, the whole message value is tested.

op.description: Comparison. Any unrecognised value falls through to "exists".

manifest.description: Routes on a predicate: config.field / config.op (eq,neq,gt,lt,contains,exists) / config.value.

artifacts.name: symbia.transform.map
artifacts.description: Reshapes an object using config.mapping — {newKey: "sourceKey"}. Deterministic.

outputs.name: error
outputs.laneNote: a refusal is not a recomputable value

mapping.description: Output field to source field, {newKey: "sourceKey"}. Empty mapping passes the object through unchanged.

manifest.description: Reshapes an object using config.mapping — {newKey: "sourceKey"}. Deterministic.

artifacts.description: Writes the value to the execution log and passes it through.

manifest.description: Writes the value to the execution log and passes it through.

artifacts.description: Terminal node. Collects results for the execution output.

manifest.description: Terminal node. Collects results for the execution output.

artifacts.name: symbia.io.passthrough
artifacts.description: Emits its input unchanged. Graph entry point.

manifest.description: Emits its input unchanged. Graph entry point.
